plan.name: Search for a clean plate in cabinets and drawers
plan.strategy: Systematically search through storage areas like cabinets and drawers to locate a clean plate, then place it on the countertop.
steps: Check all cabinets (cabinet 1 to 6) for a clean plate.
If not found in cabinets, check drawers (drawer 1 to 3) for a clean plate.
If found, pick up the plate and place it on any of the countertops (countertop 1, 2, or 3).
